notes: The article precedes its head noun with a prepositional phrase interposed, so it keeps the discontinuous *the … that* under rule 31; ἐν αὐτῇ is the portmanteau *therein* under rule 81 with the supplied copula riding on the prepositional predicate.
ἤγγικεν heads on *nigh* under rule 91, the corpus spending *nigh* on the ἐγγ- family.
